headline: Chile October Inflation Rises 0.5% Driven by Fuel and Produce Prices
summary: Chile's consumer price index rose 0.5% in October, pushing annual inflation to an 18-month high and increasing monetary pressure on the Central Bank of Chile amid sharp rises in fuel costs.
why: Chilean CPI readings guide central bank interest rate decisions and indexed debt obligations.

impacts.name: Chilean Peso
impacts.why: Accelerating inflation creates expectations that central bank rate cuts may be paused.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Higher fuel and food costs pushed annual CPI to 18-month highs, lifting market yields on interest rate expectations.
